source_instruction: i'm looking for hyaluronic acid  for skin care moisturizers.
query: Ugh, I totally forgot to pick up a new loofah for my shower yesterday, the old one got all gross and mildewy after I left it sitting in a puddle on the tub edge, plus I need to restock my favorite lavender bubble bath that makes my whole bathroom smell like a spa after a long day at work, and I’ve also been meaning to grab those fuzzy non-slip socks to wear when I do my nighttime skincare routine so my feet don’t get cold on the tile. Anyway, I’m looking for a cruelty free makeup remover that has hyaluronic acid in it, I just want a good price on it, no crazy expensive options please.
